test('native saved steps survive actual disconnection, same-run switching and reopening without automatic resend', async ({ page, context }) => {
  test.setTimeout(120000)
  // Reopening resumes the run from its journal; holding that request shows the controls wait for it.
  let delayResume = false, sawResume!: () => void
  const resumingReopenedRun = new Promise<void>(resolve => { sawResume = resolve })
  await page.route('**/api/review/runtime', async route => {
    if (delayResume && route.request().postDataJSON()?.action === 'resume') {
      delayResume = false; sawResume()
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000))
    }
    await route.continue()
  })
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 1000 })
  await page.goto('/review?familyDay=1')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start 1,000-item run' }).click()
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Disconnect app' })).toBeEnabled()
  const app = page.frameLocator('iframe[title="Synthetic Laundry App"]')
  await expect(app.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Laundry', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  const run = await app.locator('body').evaluate(() => window.reviewRuntime!.status().run)
  await page.mouse.move(1200, 800); await page.mouse.wheel(0, 900)
  await app.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sort 1000 pieces into loads', exact: true }).click()
  await app.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review next load', exact: true }).click()
  await app.getByRole('button', { name: 'I’m at the laundry room', exact: true }).click()
  await app.getByRole('button', { name: /^Confirm recipe for/ }).click()
  await app.getByRole('button', { name: 'See what goes in', exact: true }).click()
  await app.getByRole('button', { name: /^(Start|Continue) preparation$/ }).click()
  await expect(app.getByText('Step 1 of 4', { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await context.setOffline(true)
  await expect.poll(() => app.locator('body').evaluate(() => navigator.onLine)).toBe(false)
  await app.getByRole('button', { name: 'Done · next step', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Saved steps' })).toContainText('actions:recordAction')
  const receipt = await app.locator('body').evaluate(() => window.reviewRuntime!.status().pending[0])
  expect(receipt.args).toMatchObject({ status: 'confirmed', receiptId: expect.any(String), expectedTimelineRevision: expect.any(Number) })
  await context.setOffline(false)
  await expect.poll(() => app.locator('body').evaluate(() => navigator.onLine)).toBe(false)
  await page.getByLabel('Synthetic account').selectOption('member')
  await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Saved steps' })).toHaveCount(0)
  await page.getByLabel('Synthetic account').selectOption('owner')
  await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Saved steps' })).toBeVisible()
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close app', exact: true }).click()
  delayResume = true
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reopen app', exact: true }).click()
  await resumingReopenedRun
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconnect app', exact: true })).toBeDisabled()
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconnect app', exact: true })).toBeEnabled()
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconnect app', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(app.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send saved step', exact: true })).toBeEnabled()
  expect(await app.locator('body').evaluate(() => window.reviewRuntime!.status().run)).toBe(run)
  expect(await app.locator('body').evaluate(() => window.reviewRuntime!.status().pending[0]!.args)).toEqual(receipt.args)
  await page.mouse.move(1200, 800); await page.mouse.wheel(0, 900)
  await app.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send saved step', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Saved steps' })).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(app.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send saved step', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)
  const project = await app.locator('body').evaluate(async () => (await window.reviewPreview!.recording!()).project)
  const actor = await app.locator('body').evaluate(() => window.reviewRuntime!.status().subject)
  const detail = await page.request.post('/api/review/runtime', { headers: { 'x-rehearsal-project': project }, data: { action: 'query', run, actor, name: 'execution:sessionDetail', args: { sessionId: receipt.args.sessionId } } })
  expect(detail.ok()).toBe(true)
  expect((await detail.json()).actions.find((row: { id: string }) => row.id === receipt.args.actionId).status).toBe('confirmed')
  await app.getByRole('button', { name: /^(Start|Continue) preparation$/ }).click()
  await expect(app.getByText('Step 2 of 4', { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
})

test('one load goes from washing through drying to a partial and then full put-away in the same run', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(240000)
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 1000 })
  await page.goto('/review?familyDay=1')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start 1,000-item run' }).click()
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Disconnect app' })).toBeEnabled()
  const app = page.frameLocator('iframe[title="Synthetic Laundry App"]')
  await expect(app.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Laundry', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  const status = () => app.locator('body').evaluate(() => window.reviewRuntime!.status())
  const screen = () => app.locator('body').evaluate(() => window.reviewPreview!.state()?.screen)
  const { run, subject } = await status()
  const project = await app.locator('body').evaluate(async () => (await window.reviewPreview!.recording!()).project)
  // The run's own records, read as the acting account through the run service.
  const query = async (name: string, args: unknown) => {
    const response = await page.request.post('/api/review/runtime', { headers: { 'x-rehearsal-project': project }, data: { action: 'query', run, actor: subject, name, args } })
    expect(response.ok()).toBe(true)
    return response.json()
  }
  const householdId = (await query('households:onboardingStatus', {})).households[0].householdId as string
  const pieces = async () => (await query('inventory:list', { householdId })).textiles as { textileId: string; status: string }[]
  const before = await pieces()
  const clean = (rows: { status: string }[]) => rows.filter((row) => row.status === 'clean').length
  // The frame sits in a scrolling workspace; bring the app's controls into view before each tap.
  const tap = async (name: string | RegExp) => { await page.mouse.move(1200, 800); await page.mouse.wheel(0, 900); await app.getByRole('button', { name, exact: typeof name === 'string' }).click() }
  await tap('Sort 1000 pieces into loads')
  await tap('Review next load')
  await tap('I’m at the laundry room')
  await tap(/^Confirm recipe for/)
  await tap('See what goes in')
  await tap(/^(Start|Continue) preparation$/)
  for (const step of [1, 2, 3]) {
    await expect(app.getByText(`Step ${step} of 4`, { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await tap('Done · next step')
  }
  await expect(app.getByText('Step 4 of 4', { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await app.getByLabel(/^Minutes shown on/).fill('40')
  await tap(/^I’ve started/)
  await expect.poll(screen).toBe('family.washing')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Advance synthetic time 40 min' }).click()
  await expect(app.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Take it out and hang it' })).toBeVisible()
  await tap('It’s hanging')
  await tap('Move to drying queue')
  await expect.poll(screen, { timeout: 30000 }).toBe('family.drying')
  await tap('Hang 20 pieces to dry')
  await tap(/20 pieces · .*Check when dry$/)
  await expect(app.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Is it dry?' })).toBeVisible()
  // Partial: one piece stays damp and keeps drying; the other 19 are put away.
  await tap(/^Fewer dry /)
  await tap('Put away 19 · keep 1 drying')
  await expect(app.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Not dry yet' })).toBeVisible()
  await tap('Put away 19 pieces')
  await expect.poll(async () => clean(await pieces()) - clean(before), { timeout: 30000 }).toBe(19)
  await tap(/1 piece · .*Check when dry$/)
  await tap('Put away 1 dry piece')
  await tap('Put away 1 piece')
  await expect(app.getByRole('heading', { name: 'No clothes to dry right now' })).toBeVisible()
  await expect.poll(async () => clean(await pieces()) - clean(before), { timeout: 30000 }).toBe(20)
  // Same run and the same original pieces throughout: nothing was replaced or reset.
  const after = await pieces()
  expect(after.map((row) => row.textileId)).toEqual(before.map((row) => row.textileId))
  expect(after).toHaveLength(1000)
  expect((await status()).run).toBe(run)
  expect(await app.locator('#review-root').getAttribute('data-rehearsal-run-error')).toBeNull()
})

  await page.route('**/*', async (route) => {

import { resolve } from 'node:path'
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test'
import scenarios from '../src/review/scenarios.json' with { type: 'json' }

// Authentication secrets must not enter browser trace artifacts.
test.use({ trace: 'off', viewport: { width: 1280, height: 1400 } })
test.skip(process.env.WASHCLOSET_REVIEW_E2E !== '1', 'Run explicitly against the isolated review server.')

test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {

test('review opens real synthetic sheets without a household connection', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
  const errors: string[] = []
  const backend: string[] = []
  page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message))
  page.on('request', (request) => { if (/:(3220|3221|3258|3259|1)\//.test(request.url())) backend.push(request.url()) })
  await page.goto('/review?legacy=1&scenario=intake.pack.final')
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Review key', { exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)
  expect((await page.request.get('/api/review/index')).ok()).toBe(true)
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'CIVIC · Review' })).toBeVisible()
  const frame = page.frameLocator('iframe')
  await expect(frame.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save item', exact: true })).toBeEnabled()
  await expect(frame.locator('.sheet[data-starting-style]')).toHaveCount(0)
  await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath('review-desktop.png'), fullPage: true, animations: 'disabled' })
  await frame.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save item', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(frame.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Saved', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  const data = await page.locator('iframe').evaluate((iframe: HTMLIFrameElement) => iframe.contentWindow!.reviewPreview!.data())
  expect(data.textiles.filter((piece) => piece.name === 'Everyday multicolor tee pack')).toHaveLength(6)
  await page.reload()
  await expect(frame.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save item', exact: true })).toBeEnabled()
  const reloaded = await page.locator('iframe').evaluate((iframe: HTMLIFrameElement) => iframe.contentWindow!.reviewPreview!.data())
  expect(reloaded.textiles.length).toBe(data.textiles.length)
  expect(backend).toEqual([])
  expect(errors).toEqual([])
})
